entry.title: Dedicated music selection block
entry.notes: Music selection takes substantial time. Budget a dedicated 30–45-minute session for auditioning tracks against the actual footage; do not assume the entire music pass will fit in one session. Match rhythm, tempo and emotional tone to playback speed. Gentle atmospheric tracks may clash with sped-up work montages; test a more defined, upbeat rhythmic pulse. Keep music on separate Premiere Pro audio tracks for easy replacement.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Premiere Pro Editing — Vlog #2 Experiment
entry.notes:
Objective: Reduce tedious footage handling and preliminary assembly while retaining full editorial judgment over story, humor, pacing, music, and the final cut.
Timing: Vlog #1 remains entirely manually edited to establish a creative baseline. After Vlog #1 is published, test Premiere Pro built-in AI features and assess Codex + an unofficial Premiere Pro MCP integration. Consider piloting the assisted process on Vlog #2; not a committed workflow or start date.
Proposed pipeline: 1) Import DJI Osmo Action 6 footage into Premiere. 2) Transcribe with Whisper/WhisperX and organize clips with timestamps. 3) Use visual analysis to tag scenes and identify notable reactions/reflections. 4) Generate possible narrative arcs from actual footage. 5) User picks a narrative direction. 6) Test Codex + Premiere MCP to build an editable preliminary timeline if integration works. 7) User manually refines storytelling, rhythm, sound design, color, and final cut.
Tools to evaluate: Premiere native AI and text-based editing; Codex with unofficial community Premiere MCP; local Whisper/WhisperX transcription; separate footage/visual analysis. MCP editing commands alone do not understand footage content.
Test criteria: setup difficulty, data privacy, timeline accuracy, project/sequence compatibility, editability, time saved versus manual Vlog #1 baseline, and whether AI suggestions reduce or dilute the creator's own storytelling judgment. Work on a duplicate Premiere project; verify capabilities and safety before letting automation alter a timeline.
Alternative: Trial this approach before committing effort to building the standalone Story Producer Windows application.
Repository to evaluate (not vetted for reliability/security): https://github.com/hetpatel-11/Adobe_Premiere_Pro_MCP
Limitations: community integration is unofficial and untested; support and editing scope depend on the current version; no assumption of native ChatGPT conversational timeline editing or any release date.
